commitResults.messageBody: Verify all ten bundled connections and supplied distances, name-based references, optional fields, enum combinations, duplicate and malformed-line recovery, and resource or I/O failures without altering the reference data.

commitResults.messageBody: Reuse FacilityManager for feature and status filtering, default omitted status to YES, and explain UNKNOWN results. Validate search arguments while preserving list, view, and exit commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Finalize facility commands and expand CLI testing
commitResults.messageBody:
Use facility HUB for direct lookups and show all recorded accessibility details in facility list. Keep invalid input recoverable with consistent warnings and separate parsing from command execution.

Update the User Guide and regression tests. Verified with 131 JUnit tests, 100 additional console scenarios including 3 packaged-JAR checks, and zero Checkstyle violations.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move facility output formatting into UI helpers
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep Facility command execution focused on manager queries and error handling by moving list, lookup, search, and warning messages into FacilityOutputFormatter. Preserve the existing output and reuse the individual facility detail formatter.

Verified with 131 JUnit tests, 100 console scenarios including 3 packaged-JAR checks, and zero Checkstyle violations. Existing test assertions remain unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve console readability with response borders and welcome logo
commitResults.messageBody: Group each complete response between horizontal lines, display the UniEnable ASCII logo below the greeting, and split the accessibility disclaimer onto two lines. Update the console expectations, add UI output tests, and align the User Guide example.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reserve activity work and simplify the console loop
commitResults.messageBody:
Activity commands need separate files and clear ownership before
teammates begin implementing their assigned features.

Add empty command, parser, and test placeholders with numbered branch
markers. Document shared integration points without implementing any
reserved functionality.

Extract dataset loading and command execution from main so recovery
and exit behavior remain easy to follow.

Validation: Java 25 Gradle check passed with 140 tests and no
Checkstyle violations.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix facility identifiers and lookup usage
commitResults.messageBody:
Uppercase normalization differs from case-insensitive lookup for
Unicode identifiers, and padded dataset IDs and names are accepted
even though lookup cannot resolve them.

Reject surrounding identifier whitespace with line-numbered warnings
and compare duplicate IDs and names using the same case-insensitive
comparison as lookup. Preserve accepted spelling, features, and text.

Use facility LOCATION consistently in usage messages, tests, and
documentation. Add six regression tests for identifier validation,
Unicode duplicate handling, and distinct uppercase expansions.

Validation: 140 JUnit tests passed; Gradle check, shadowJar, and
Checkstyle completed successfully.

Validated with test resources excluded: 213 tests pass, Checkstyle passes, and facility/connection coverage remains 100% for 402 lines and 217 branches. Each test file stays below 500 lines.
